oneOf.description: Plain text. Racebin stores the content as text and never interprets it as HTML.

Rich-text HTML. Racebin sanitizes and normalizes the supported markup,

render it according to their own platform's secure HTML practices.

post.description: Creates a paste. Query metadata is accepted only for raw bodies. text/plain creates text and accepts an optional language; text/markdown creates text with language=markdown; text/html creates sanitized rich text and does not accept language. The raw request body is always the content. JSON, URL-encoded, and multipart requests carry creation fields exclusively in the body. An omitted structured body creates empty text. expires_at and expires_in are mutually exclusive. Clients may request text/plain instead of JSON to receive only the created paste URL.
